rootCause.htmlBranch: Protocol-relative //duckduckgo.com/l/ links satisfy startsWith slash, then an extra origin is prepended, producing https://duckduckgo.com//duckduckgo.com/l/.
rootCause.originalSourceLoss: uddg contains the original source URL, but the parser returns a malformed search-engine URL rather than that original source.
rootCause.liteBranch: The current http-prefix-only filter does not accept protocol-relative result links; that branch has no equivalent source normalization.

notProven: The original source pages have not yet been fetched through a corrected product path.
No full retrieval/verification/summary run or original-source claim acceptance has occurred.
The proposed normalizer would provide URL-syntax checks, not proof against DNS rebinding or arbitrary redirect SSRF.

behavior: Use standard URL parsing for absolute, protocol-relative and root-relative result links.
Unwrap recognized DuckDuckGo result redirects once, retaining the original target query/path.
Apply the same normalization and deduplication to HTML and lite results without changing search providers.
Reject invalid schemes, embedded credentials, internal navigation and literal private/local destinations before treating a URL as a public source.
Add regressions for actual observed link shape, query encoding, deduplication, lite fallback, empty results and malformed redirects.
constraints: Local development and bounded verification only; no production deployment.
No provider/router/Ollama, credential, permission, port, DNS, Relay or native-Agent-message change.
